states.layout: Same entry art; replace choices with two labeled fields, submit and recovery. Scroll content above keyboard; preserve field values on language changes, never persist password.

states.rule: One in-flight request. Localize progress. Disable duplicate submission; never award game progress.
Normal cancellation, not an error; keep provider choice available.
Explain network requirement. Preserve non-sensitive typed context; never invent a session.
Allow explicit retry; discard unfinished identity exchange.
Preserve game data; reauthenticate; no automatic account reset.
Respect server retry interval; accessible localized countdown if supplied.

create.rule: Collect reviewed age/region/consent requirements before creating the game profile; do not invent universal guardian thresholds.

google.existing_account: Use backend-authorized setup/consent checkpoint or WIN-001
google.new_identity: Minimal pending onboarding only, then WIN-006/007 and WIN-008 when applicable before activating a fitness profile. Provider identity is not fitness-data consent.

authentication_success.rule: Backend-authorized resume checkpoint, not an arbitrary client redirect. No direct Home route until required account checks complete.

privacy.rule: Public read-only document view; opening it does not record consent.

terms.rule: Public read-only document view; opening it does not record consent.

security_contract.password: Only in the input control/request lifetime; never written to PlayerPrefs, logs, fixtures or analytics.
security_contract.token_storage: Platform-protected storage; backend session/revocation design required before live authentication.
security_contract.google: Native SDK/Credential Manager where supported; server validates signature/aud/iss/exp and identifies by sub. Do not link identities by email alone.
security_contract.oauth: Use platform auth session or external browser and PKCE/state/nonce as applicable; never collect Google credentials inside an app-owned WebView.
security_contract.consent: No bundled 'continuing accepts everything' statement and no preselected optional permission.
security_contract.preview: Never simulate successful Google/email authentication as a real account. Any local preview is explicitly identified.

visual_contract.safe_area: Fit recorded reference aspect without stretching; artwork can crop only under an approved responsive layout.
visual_contract.provider_branding: Generated provider mark in a proposal is illustrative, not an approved production asset. Use official Google/native Apple controls and review their exact final geometry.
visual_contract.email_step: Reuse background/frame; its field/keyboard composition must be reviewed before declaring WIN-002 implementation complete.
visual_contract.verification: Complete window first; one full-screen comparison per locale after assembly, plus focused auth cancellation/error and keyboard interaction checks. No per-button render loop.

implementation_dependencies: Chosen authentication service and owned project
Google OAuth client IDs and final Android signing-certificate registration
Reviewed account eligibility and consent rules
iOS equivalent login decision and Apple developer configuration
